class.name: ResourceLazyLoader
class.brief_description: Resources loaded when they are wanted and let go when nobody wants them.
class.description: Holds the resources needed only while something near the camera uses them - a scenery's models, its terrain - so their memory, RAM and the VRAM of a mesh or a texture, goes back once nothing holds them. A resource is registered under a key with the [Callable] that loads it; one key is one resource, shared by everybody who registers it. [method resource_fetch] holds it, [method resource_release] lets it go. A copy still alive elsewhere is handed out again rather than loaded twice. Everything held is let go when the game's data is unloaded ([signal GameDataServer.data_unload_requested]). Thread-safe.

method.name: resource_fetch
method.description: Loads the resource unless it is in memory, and holds it until the matching [method resource_release]. Nothing is held when it cannot be loaded.

method.name: resource_free
method.description: Frees one registration; the resource goes with the last one.

method.name: resource_is_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while somebody holds the resource.

method.name: resource_load
method.description: Loads the resource unless it is in memory, without holding it - for a worker preparing what the main thread then fetches.

method.name: resource_register
method.description: Registers the resource [param loader] ([code]() -> Resource[/code]) loads. The same [param key] gives the same RID; each registration is freed by its own [method resource_free].

method.name: resource_release
method.description: Lets go of a resource held by [method resource_fetch]; once nobody holds it, the loader keeps no reference of its own.
